compliance_rules.name: Mandatory Submission of Identity & Academic Records

policy_reference.title: AICTE Approval Process Handbook (Section 2.4 - Document Verification Norms)
policy_reference.authority: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
policy_reference.excerpt: Every candidate applying for scholarship or admission scrutiny must submit verified government identity proof along with qualifying degree/marksheet certificates.

compliance_rules.explanation: Validates that applicant has submitted at minimum an identity document and an academic certificate.
compliance_rules.remediation_instructions: Upload the missing mandatory document (Aadhaar/Identity card or Academic transcript).

compliance_rules.name: Income Certificate Current Financial Year Validity

policy_reference.title: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Operational Guidelines
policy_reference.authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
policy_reference.excerpt: Income certificates submitted for fee waiver or scholarship must be issued within the valid financial year and cannot be expired at the time of application submission.

compliance_rules.explanation: Ensures income certificates reflect current financial eligibility and have not expired.
compliance_rules.remediation_instructions: Submit a renewed income certificate issued by a competent Revenue Authority (Tehsildar / SDO).

compliance_rules.name: Family Annual Income Ceiling Compliance

policy_reference.title: AICTE Pragati & Saksham Scholarship Guidelines
policy_reference.excerpt: Total family annual income from all sources should not exceed INR 8,00,000/- per annum for the grant of scholarship.

compliance_rules.explanation: Verifies that certified annual family income does not exceed ₹8,00,000 threshold.
compliance_rules.remediation_instructions: If income exceeds the scheme cap, the applicant is ineligible for this specific income-restricted grant.

compliance_rules.name: Cross-Document Legal Identity Consistency

policy_reference.title: General Standards for Academic Credentials Scrutiny
policy_reference.excerpt: The name of the applicant on all academic credentials must be reconcilable with the primary identity record. Discrepancies without gazette notification require administrative hold.

compliance_rules.explanation: Detects identity mismatches between official certificates and declared applicant credentials.
compliance_rules.remediation_instructions: Upload Gazette notification, marriage certificate, or an affidavit explaining the name variation.

compliance_rules.name: Minimum Qualifying Examination Percentage

policy_reference.title: AICTE Approval Process Handbook (Entry Qualification Standards)
policy_reference.excerpt: Passed 10+2 examination with minimum 45% marks (40% for candidates belonging to reserved category) in the above subjects taken together.

compliance_rules.explanation: Verifies that academic transcript confirms minimum entry threshold of 45%.
compliance_rules.remediation_instructions: Candidate must meet the minimum qualifying marks specified by the regulatory body.
